fusions.name: Trail's End
fusions.desc: Kicks a target at or below 30% health, dealing 24 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Read the Ground
fusions.desc: Kicks through a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage to each enemy and leaving it [Marked] for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Where the Gaze Lands
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away, and your dodge chance rises by 8%.

fusions.name: No Print Missed
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 10% more damage, and your dodge chance rises by 4% at all times.
